lines.text: Micah from the hill country of Ephraim admits to his mother that he took her eleven hundred shekels of silver.
His mother gives two hundred shekels of silver to a silversmith, who makes a graven image and a molten idol.
Micah has a shrine, makes an ephod and household idols, and ordains one of his sons as his priest.
A young Levite leaves Hebron in Judah and comes to Micah's house.
Micah offers the Levite twenty shekels of silver per year, clothes, and provisions, and ordains him as his priest.
